title: Item:Splinterskull Historical Documents
wikitext:
[[Image:Splinterskull Historical Documents.png|right]]
This item can be found in the Level 11 quest [[The Spawn of Whisperdoom]]. Once outside the quest, the [[Ungurz Lieutenant]] will exchange the '''Splinterskull Historical Documents'''  for your choice from a short list of randomly generated items - the [[Item:Widowblight|Widowblight]] sickle has a rare chance to be in that list.
